args.summary: The v2.3.1 production deploy of checkout-api failed health checks, driving the error rate to ~18%. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error, halted after us-east); a retry completed the rollout to the remaining regions. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 with an error rate of ~0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident was actually created despite the timeout (INC-0001, status: open), so no retry was needed. All done.

**Summary:**

1. **Diagnosed:** `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production after the latest deploy, with health check failures.
2. **Rolled back:** All production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east); a retry completed the remaining regions.
3. **Verified:** Service is now healthy across all regions on v2.3.0, with the error rate down from ~18% to ~0.2%.
4. **Incident opened:** **INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the partial rollback failure and retry, and the final healthy state.

Recommendation: investigate v2.3.1 before redeploying (it was never healthy in production, so a redeploy would require change-manager approval).
